verdict.rationale: Elastic's own marketing documents natural-language interaction with telemetry, and ES|QL is positioned as the engine behind AI investigations. Nothing in the pack shows a natural-language question being turned into a real ES|QL query or chart, so only the 'ask in natural language' half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented NL-to-query (ES|QL/PromQL) generation, NL-to-chart/visualization output, in-depth first-party docs beyond a marketing line, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
ES|QL delivers sub-second responses on millions of time series metrics — the speed AI investigations demand.
